### Ehud and Eglon
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ehud-and-eglon
Passage: Judges 3:30
Points:
- Following the death of Othniel, Israel slid into apostasy, prompting the Lord to strengthen King Eglon of Moab to discipline them.
- God displayed His sovereign rule over both His covenant people and their adversaries by raising up Ehud to bring deliverance.
- Acting in a time of war, Ehud served as an instrument of divine justice by using military cunning to defeat the oppressor.
- Eglon's humiliating defeat demonstrates that the Lord holds His foes in derision and will bring to nothing all who oppose Him.
